 Cancer Horoscope for November 2026
 June 21 - July 22 
 Share
 Your November 2026 Horoscope for Cancer
 by Susan Miller 
 You will find it easier to manage money once Mars leaves Leo and enters Virgo on November 25. This change will allow you to travel short distances, and you won’t need to focus as much on money management.
 The new moon on November 9 that I referred to earlier will be in compatible Scorpio, and although this moon is at odds with your financial second house (requiring practical considerations), you can still find less expensive ways to relax and unwind in your time off. This new moon will also give you time to be with your children if you feel you’ve been preoccupied with your career.
 You’re also working under a retrograde Mercury for part of this month, a trend that started on October 24. Venus has been retrograde for even longer, since October 3. Interestingly, both planets will go direct on the same day, November 13. After that date, you will feel life speed up, and you will experience fewer frustrations.
 Your social life will see an uptick in November, and life is about to become more joyful overall. At work there will be fewer glitches, and you won’t find as many inaccuracies that require you to redo parts of a project. Venus rules your home, so if you are renovating your home, in the process of buying new furniture, or looking for a new place to live, you are more likely to find beautiful options once Venus turns direct on November 13. Refrain from scheduling any expensive dermatological treatments like Botox or fillers until Venus—who is associated with your face—is moving forward and no longer debilitated by retrograde (after November 13).
 A very special conjunction of Mars and Jupiter in your income sector this month could bring you the chance to make more money.
